chat.t: I'm the bear mascot from DD TOWN...
Are you the one who gave me your number earlier...?

o: Why are you being so polite?
You weren't like this earlier.
You were talking down to me when we first met.
My nose is stinging so much right now that I won't be able to sleep.
I can't just let this slide.
Really, anything?
Even when you don't know what I want?

chat.t: I'll be waiting for your message...

lines.t: Alleyway
My first day off in a while. I was almost dragged by the freeloaders at the Hideout to buy the limited edition DD TOWN macaron set, but...
While they were distracted, I successfully escaped into the back alleys.
Rushing to the store at opening time for a macaron set on my day off? No thanks.
What was that?
A rat?
What is it... What's the problem...!
Ah... What am I supposed to do in this situation...?
(This voice...)
(She has to be a total babe.)
Should I check it out?
I'm checking it out!
Ugh... Is it a problem with the charging cable? Or should I take the head off and put it back on...?
Is something wrong?
Gasp!
The moment I spoke, a white cable slammed into my face...
Aaaah! A-Are you okay?!?!
And after that, I blacked out.
Where am I?
Who am I?
I definitely... spoke to a girl in a bear mascot suit... and then got hit by something...
And she just... left me here unconscious? Seriously?
Just wait till I find you... I'm going to make you pay.
Station Front Street
Alright, alright! Only one flyer per person!
Bring this flyer with you and get a free raffle ticket!
That hit-and-run driver...
Look at her, working so shamelessly.
Hey there, mister! You want a raffle ticket, too...?
Hey, give me one too.
Y-You!!!
How dare you hit and run and just leave the victim behind? I've got you now.
Th-That was because we were running out of time for the event...!!
Someone collapsed, and you care more about work?
Ugh... That's... I'm sorry.
Wh-What do you want me to do?!
If it's a settlement, I'll somehow scrape it together!
Mio? You're supposed to be working right now.
Showing up late, and now wasting time chatting...
How many times do I have to let things slide before you actually do your job?
Ah! I'll work hard!!
Hey, can we talk about this later?!
I'll do whatever you say, whether it's a settlement or anything else!
You definitely said you'd do whatever I say, right?
Ah! Fine, I get it!!
I wrote my phone number on the back of the flyer and handed it to Mio.
Message me.
Or I'm reporting you.
Ugh... I-I get it!!  I-I'll contact you later!!
Now... what should I have her do?

chat.t: Around when... might you contact me...?

o: Just wait.
You're the one who ran me over, and you're already rushing me?

chat.t: I suppose contacting you first was rude of me...

o: You're acting completely different from how you were in person.
You were a total bully in person.

chat.t: When I wear the mascot suit, since I can't really see people's faces...
It... boosts my confidence, I guess...

o: Never mind that, meet me right now.
Why? You can't?
Didn't you want me to contact you?

chat.t: Thanks to you, I was able to wrap things up safely.

o: The gap between you in person and online is unreal.

chat.t: I'm so sorry if I made you uncomfortable!!!
Please message me when you have some time later!

lines.t: Station Front Street
I arrived at the plaza past the promised time. Since I was already late anyway, I leisurely headed to the meeting spot.
You're thirty minutes late!!
Oh look at you. Are you seriously getting mad at me? Miss Hit-and-Run Bear Mask?
What?! That has nothing to do with being late!
You're way more shameless than I thought. You were bowing and scraping on MochiTalk.
Th-That was just basic etiquette for MochiTalk!
I was just being polite!
Anyway, so what do you want?
Money?! So you need money after all?!
Nope. What I want isn't something material like that.
Take it off, right now.
...What?
Didn't you hear me? Take it off.
T-T-T-T-T-T-Take... Take it off...?!?!
How dare she run away right in front of me?
I'll chase you to the ends of the earth!!And I'm going to strip you naked!!
Park
You look exhausted. Why don't you stop running?
Gasp!... Gasp!... Stop chasing me!!
Who are you guys? If you want to run, do it safely on the track... Huh?
The end of my brand-new, limited-edition black Aibaki barbell that I just bought... The end...!!
It got stripped off!!!
Str... Stripped?!?
Why did something else get stripped off?!
To buy this, I... I!!! For months...!!!
Hey, calm down first. There's no problem with you working out, is there?
What? No problem?
I'll deadlift with your head instead of a barbell! You damn bear head!!
This can't be... My muscles, kneeling before a barbell destroyer?
Don't look down on my muscles trained by drumming!
...Oh, wait, that's not it.  First of all, I'm sorry.
Your barbell?  Since it got ruined.
You really are terrible at talking...
I'll handle this, so just wait.
W-What?! Why!!
I get that the barbell is precious, but aren't you overreacting a bit?
Look, she's trying to apologize too.
Ugh... I'm sorry...
And another thing.
Once you unwrap something, you have to expect a few everyday scratches.
That and this are...! Sigh.
Actually, you're right.
Workout equipment exists to be used, not to be shown off.
Maybe I was just drunk on the idea of myself working out...
My bad. I'm leaving to find the true meaning of working out.
I can't believe things worked out like this.
If you had just spoken properly from the start, we wouldn't have had to fight.
I-I'm just bad at communicating!
I'm putting today's incident on your tab too.
So now you owe me twice.
I-I'll do whatever you want!
Except... taking off this mascot head!
Hmm... Alright. I'll contact you later.

chat.t: Um, you haven't contacted me at all...
By any chance, around when... might I be able to pay back my debt?

o: The time hasn't come yet.
You're more impatient than you look.

chat.t: Maybe I should delete your number and reflect on myself...

o: How dare you act so cheeky?
That does it. Meet me outside.
For what?

chat.t: If you ever need help, just let me know!

o: Then should we meet barefaced next time?

lines.t: Some Forest
I really have no idea what's going on.
What?
Why did we suddenly come to the forest?!?! This is way too out of the blue!
I got a request. They want us to find a bear in the forest.
A-A bear?! Are you talking about a real bear?!?!
You can handle a bear.
Since you're a bear too.
Do you seriously think I'm a real bear?!?! I'm a human!!
I'm just wearing a mascot suit! There's no way I'm a real bear!!!
What? You can't even catch a bear? I'm disappointed.
You... You...!!!
Well, I'm not telling you to catch a real bear.
The request is to capture two runaway Flurries, and apparently they're wearing bear-ear headbands.
Phew, so they're pet Flurries. Got it! Let's do this!!
Finding some Flurries will be a piece of cake! Just trust me!
One hour later...
Hey, are you done yet?
I-It's only been an hour, so just wait a bit!
Two hours later...
Where did the person who was looking for the Flurries go?
Ugh... I'm going to find them soon!!
Hold on, stop!
You're disappointed, aren't you? Since I can't even do such a simple task...
But I'll keep looking...
No, I said stop!
That's a bear.
What...?

Flashing eyes in the bushes far away, a low growling sound,
a massive build... It was a real bear.
Argh...! Run!!
What on earth is happening?!
How should I know?
Why is a real bear showing up instead of a bear-like Flurry?!
Less complaining, more running!
I am running!! More importantly, look ahead!!
Whew, looks like the bear went back... Huh? This is... the mascot head.
Ugh... What is this...
Are you okay?
Ha! Don't worry about me...
No, I mean, because your head is missing.

Wait, what... Huh...?
Aaah! M-M-M-My head!!!!!
W-W-W-Where did it go...?! I-I can't function without it...
Calm down.
Y-Yeah, you're right...?  I-It'll be okay... Mio, you're okay...
Why are you shaking so much?
That's because... I only take it off... in front of my bandmates...
The world is so...  so scary...!!
Even I think... I'm so weird... You probably think I'm weird too...
*Sniffle*... What do I do... I-I'm scared...
You're not weird.
I never said you were weird to begin with, so why are you so scared?
Ummm... Are you... really sure I'm not weird?
Even though I go around wearing a bear mascot suit...?
There are plenty of weird people besides you.
There's even a bakery owner who chases customers with a chainsaw, so a bear mascot suit is no big deal.
(Puts the mascot head back on her)
Ah! Th... Thank you...!
Well... it's too dangerous to keep looking. Let's go back.
Y-Yeah!
Station Front Street
U-Um... today!!! I'm sorry I wasn't of any help!!
Well, I was pretty satisfied.
(Getting to see the beautiful face hidden inside was definitely worth it. Oh, yeah.)
...It's a first.
For someone to treat me so normally after seeing my real face...
What? Why did you stop talking?
Oh, nothing...! Whenever!!
If you ever need me, just call!!
